title: [Slice-631381] Add Mark as Accepted in posted documents for Spanish SII
summary: Spanish SII posted documents now include a Mark as Accepted action to resolve stuck Incorrect or Pending statuses directly from the document page, matching the behavior available on the SII History page.
key_points: New Mark as Accepted action added to posted sales, purchase, and service invoice and credit memo pages for Spanish localization
Resolves SII document status by source, type, and number without requiring the SII posting date to match
Action gated behind SII enabled check and Show Advanced Actions setting
Returns success status to the page which handles user messaging
Nine new tests added covering happy path scenarios and edge cases
quote: Documents can get stuck in an Incorrect or Pending SII status and there was no way to clear that from the posted document itself.
